channel.title: San Diego Community Newsgroup - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: Boy, 8, accosted by suspicious stranger in Bostonia
item.description: Authorities alerted the public Friday to a possible child-abduction attempt that occurred this week in a neighborhood near El Cajon.

item.title: Leading member of org behind Tijuana store that sold drugs sentenced to 20 years
item.description: Man accused of leading Tijuana drug ring that sold fentanyl and meth sentenced to 20 years in San Diego federal court.

item.title: Ex-Hoover High associate principal sentenced 8 years for porn possession
item.description: A former associate principal at Hoover High School was sentenced Friday to eight years in prison for possession of child sex abuse material.

item.title: SD city attorney warns of scammers posing as immigration lawyers
item.description: The San Diego City Attorney’s Office advised members of the public Friday to be wary of scammers pretending to be attorneys or government officials who request payments for immigration-related legal services. The City Attorney’s Office noted that it does not provide legal or immigration-related services, nor does it request money or sensitive personal information over […]

item.title: Opinion: Cities need their own bill of rights to protect urban freedoms
item.description: In the 21st century, cities have been increasingly asserting their residents’ local rights, and adding bills of rights to their governing documents.

item.title: San Diego County prepared for more than 150 Valentine’s Day weddings
item.description: Love is in the air, and in the bureaucracy, Saturday as more than 150 couples will be married by San Diego County's Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk's office as part of special Valentine's Day ceremonies.

item.title: Historic Spreckels Theatre is up for auction. Will a sale boost the push for a downtown arts district?
item.description: Possible buyers for Spreckels will have 48 hours when the auction opens next month to place bids, which start at $5 million.

item.title: Secret license plate readers are tracking drivers in San Diego and beyond. Who owns the cameras?
item.description: Local law enforcement’s use of license plate readers has become a focal point in debates in “sanctuary” communities, including San Diego.

item.title: University City resident fights cancer with free, little creative space for all
item.description: Wendy Carvalho, a graphic designer, reworked the Free Little Libraries idea to create the University City Free Little Art Gallery.

item.title: Jimmie Johnson says 2027 Daytona 500 will be his last
item.description: “I’ve been fortunate to accomplish more than I ever imagined in this sport,” said Johnson, the two-time Daytona 500 champion from El Cajon.
